scheme_name: Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the target group of NSKFDC.
Applicant must have secured admission in a vocational education and training course of minimum 6 months and maximum 2 years duration.

The course must be run or supported by a Ministry, Department, Government organization, or a company/society/organization supported by the National Skill Development Corporation or State Skill Missions/State Skill Corporations.
The course should lead to a certificate, diploma, degree or equivalent recognized/authorized by the Government.
benefits_summary: Provides a loan covering up to 90% of course expenses (maximum Rs 4 lakh) with interest at 1% per annum (0.5% rebate for women) and repayment term of up to 7 years.
